title: Topo Athletic Phantom 4 WP: Waterproof Trainer
excerpt: The Topo Athletic Phantom 4 WP is a waterproof version of the Phantom 4 road shoe: price, what reviewers liked and the trade-offs.
body:
Topo Athletic Phantom 4 WP: Waterproof Trainer

Updated November 2026. Prices are US list prices (MSRP) at the time of this update; retailers often sell for less.

The Topo Athletic Phantom 4 WP is the waterproof version of Topo's Phantom 4 road trainer. It adds an eVent waterproof membrane to keep your feet dry on wet, cold runs. It lists at $165 (US MSRP at the time of this update).

What reviewers found

  • Waterproofing: reviewers report it keeps feet dry in wet conditions.
  • Fit: the roomy toe box, typical of Topo, was a highlight.
  • Ride: one reviewer found the midsole firm, and another found the shoe less stable on damp pavement.

Who it's for

The Phantom 4 WP suits runners who want to keep running easy miles through wet or cold months without soaked feet. Like most waterproof shoes, it's warmer than an unlined trainer, and water can still get in over the top of the shoe in deep puddles. Save it for bad-weather easy runs, and keep a regular trainer for faster sessions and warm days.

Sources

  • believeintherun.com/shoe-reviews/topo-athletic-phantom-4-wp-review
  • fleetfeet.com/products/mens-topo-phantom-4-wp
keyTakeaway: A waterproof trainer is for cold, wet easy runs; expect a warmer, firmer shoe, and keep a regular trainer for faster days.
